incoming.name: Extinction
incoming.excerpt: Coextinction can also occur when a species loses its pollinator, or to predators in a food chain who lose their prey.

incoming.name: Pollinator decline
incoming.excerpt: Pollinator decline is based on observations made at the end of the twentieth century of the reduction in abundance of pollinators in many ecosystems worldwide.
